profile_source.status: existing research profile with documented priors/proxies; not native Juiced2 tune

accepted_match.rationale: Distinct same-model family selected; nearest available catalog-year generation selected in code; uncertain trim resolved as explicitly labeled representative production trim.

handling.provenance: Adapted existing donor profile; equal-spaced torque RPM knots/front_weight/damping/ABS assumptions; original Juiced2 tune not asserted. data/carmodels/profiles/GT4_HOND0030.txt

cars.paint_isolation: Original factory-variant palette difference masks; specular strength alone is not paint evidence

claim_limits: Exact pinned static viewer pass/culling parity only.
No claim of recovered native GT4 glass shading or paint isolation.
Requires actual native before/after visual review before publishing.

native_common_controls.source: Original FRONT MaxSteerAngle common to all 93 filename-bound native physics profiles.
native_common_controls.scope: Shared recovered game control baseline; not a manufacturer specification or exact donor tune identity.

body_collision_proxy.exclusions: Exact wheel/tire socket descendants, source wheel meshes, helmet and shadow roles; full part evidence in body-geometry-audit.json

class_availability_source.status: accepted-donor-replacement adaptation, not original native identity/tune equality

handling.provenance: Adapted existing donor profile; equal-spaced torque RPM knots/front_weight/damping/ABS assumptions; original Juiced2 tune not asserted. data/carmodels/profiles/GT4_MAZD0007.txt

cars.paint_isolation: Original factory-variant palette difference masks; specular strength alone is not paint evidence

claim_limits: Exact pinned static viewer pass/culling parity only.

native_common_controls.source: Original FRONT MaxSteerAngle common to all 93 filename-bound native physics profiles.
native_common_controls.scope: Shared recovered game control baseline; not a manufacturer specification or exact donor tune identity.

body_collision_proxy.exclusions: Exact wheel/tire socket descendants, source wheel meshes, helmet and shadow roles; full part evidence in body-geometry-audit.json

handling.provenance: Adapted existing donor profile; equal-spaced torque RPM knots/front_weight/damping/ABS assumptions; original Juiced2 tune not asserted. data/carmodels/profiles/GT4_MITS0001.txt

cars.paint_isolation: Original factory-variant palette difference masks; specular strength alone is not paint evidence

claim_limits: Exact pinned static viewer pass/culling parity only.

native_common_controls.source: Original FRONT MaxSteerAngle common to all 93 filename-bound native physics profiles.
native_common_controls.scope: Shared recovered game control baseline; not a manufacturer specification or exact donor tune identity.

body_collision_proxy.exclusions: Exact wheel/tire socket descendants, source wheel meshes, helmet and shadow roles; full part evidence in body-geometry-audit.json
